visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera captures a close-up of a collectible action figure being dusted with a small brush. (2) A man wearing black-rimmed glasses, a black baseball cap, and a black t-shirt with an Akatsuki logo appears, mimicking a coughing fit with exaggerated facial expressions and hand movements. Large variety text overlays appear on screen. (3) The man stands in a studio environment filled with shelves of paint bottles and hobby tools, speaking directly to the camera and pointing. (4) A silver-colored air purifier is introduced. A hand presses buttons on the top interface, and an LCD screen displays air quality numbers like PM2.5. (5) Detailed shots of the air purifier show moving air vents and color-changing LED indicator lights. (6) A small bottle is held near the air sensor, causing the indicator light to switch from blue to red. (7) Animated graphics illustrate the internal filtration layers and UV light sterilization process. (8) A hand removes a mesh filter and washes it directly under a running faucet in a sink. (9) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows an application monitoring air quality. (10) The man returns to a medium shot, pointing at the camera and making a 'thumbs up' gesture as the final brand logo and product name occupy the center of the frame.
